_about: Pictures for the journal's Backstory tab (Tools/LocalSpawn/generate_ui_art.py journal, 1280x720), keyed by the page's title (AgentScripts/BuildJournal.cs). Story pages are scenes from the telling; a found page is the thing itself, lying where it was found. The people pages use the residents' portraits instead.

The Pact.prompt: An ancient painted scene like an old tapestry: people of a small Norse village and towering forest guardians of root and bark facing each other across a clearing, hands and branches raised in a promise, a fire burning between them, a great forest behind.

What the Forest Does.prompt: A lone traveller seen from behind walking into a misty pine forest, footprints behind them fading away into nothing, the path dissolving into grey mist, a faint memory of a village fading in the fog behind.

The Hearth.prompt: A single small fire burning in a stone hearth beside a ring of cracked old standing stones in a dark forest clearing at night, its warm light pushing back the mist, the only light for miles.

The Portal.prompt: Cracked ancient standing stones carved with Celtic-Norse knotwork forming a great arch in a sunlit forest clearing, a faint shimmer of light between them, moss and ferns at their feet, warm and watchful.

Seven Went In.prompt: Seven travellers of an expedition seen from behind walking in a line along a forest road into a great old pine forest at noon: a leader with a spear, a soldier with a shield, a hunter with a bow, a big smith, an old carpenter, a scholar and an alchemist with a satchel.

The Day the Stones Broke.prompt: A ring of old waystones in a dark forest cracking apart with blinding blue-white light, shards flying, figures thrown in every direction by the blast, a huge dark shape looming in the trees behind.

Ingrid's Word.prompt: A woman hiding under the huge roots of a fallen tree at night, wrapped in a cloak, watching a small distant campfire glowing through the dark trees.

The Guardians.prompt: Tall forest guardians made of twisted reddish roots and bark standing still among ancient trees like sentinels, faint amber light in their eyes, moss hanging from them, a misty dark forest.

The First of Them.prompt: An enormous ancient guardian of twisted roots and bark grown into a towering figure in a vast dark hollow under a gigantic tree, glowing amber heart-light in its chest, tiny figure of a person at its feet for scale.

Troll Country.prompt: A wide northern valley of grey boulders and old stone bridges at dawn, huge mossy trolls walking their slow rounds in the distance with whole trees growing on their shoulders, mountains in the mist.

The Barrow Dead.prompt: Undead Norse warriors in rusted mail and dented helmets standing in a shield wall at the door of a burial mound at night, cold blue light in their eye sockets, mist and old grave mounds behind.

A Letter, Unsent.prompt: A folded old letter half out of a small dented tin box lying on moss, the paper covered in the same few lines of handwriting written over and over, getting messier, soft forest light.

Liv's Notes on the Stones.prompt: Pages of a scholar's notes spread on a flat stone: sketches of standing stones and a line drawn between them on a rough map, writing in three different inks, a charcoal stick and a small rune stick beside them.

The Last Smith's Note.prompt: A rusted iron plate with words scratched into it lying on an old blacksmith's anvil in a ruined abandoned forge, ash and cold coals, moss creeping over the stones.

A Waystone Rubbing.prompt: A sheet of pale birch bark with a charcoal rubbing of carved Norse runes on it, pressed against a mossy standing stone, a stick of charcoal on the ground below.

The Lost Man's Song.prompt: A torn page from an old book with a children's counting song written in a neat hand and little drawings of a road, a ford, a wolf and a fire in the margins, lying on a wooden table by a candle. The writing is only small illegible scribbles, no letters or words can be read, no title.

The Troll Toll.prompt: A much-handled trader's list on a scrap of leather with crossed-out lines, lying on a cart seat next to a round cheese, a knife and a smooth river stone. The writing is only small illegible scribbles, no letters or words can be read, no title.

Barrow Inscription.prompt: A stone lintel over a dark barrow door with old Norse letters carved deep across it, and smaller scratched letters below added much later, mist and moonlight.

The Hearth Law.prompt: An old page of house rules written in careful letters, lying on a wooden table in front of a warm stone hearth fire, a bowl of bread and a candle beside it.

A Tally on Bark.prompt: A long strip of birch bark cut with neat rows of tally notches that become crooked further along, the word FIRE cut deep at the very end, lying on a mossy log.

Something Runa Left.prompt: A small scrap of parchment tied to a pine branch with a bit of red cord at night, faint glowing moss marks on the bark around it, a fork in a misty forest path beyond.
